name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.FlipShift.one_child_integrality
title: One decodable zero child detects a planted hidden row (integrality test)
statement: Over Q, let alpha be an affine relation among prefix rows c x (sum alpha x c x = 0, alpha t = 1) with Delta alpha x integral, D invertible and e x integral. Then Delta times sum_x alpha x (c x M + e x D) D^{-1} is an integer vector z, and adding a planted f to the noise of prefix t gives z + Delta f D^{-1}.
